title: 阿克尚·金沙长廊
description: 阿克尚在金沙长廊尽头停步，白围巾向后伸展，钩索枪静垂于身侧，远处城墙进入光雾。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Akshan is an adult Shuriman adventurer with warm brown skin, swept dark hair, a short neat beard, lively eyes, and a long pale scarf. Preserve his agile human proportions and ornate golden Sentinel details. His torso is fully covered by a closed cream tunic and short jacket above opaque trousers and boots; his distinctive grappling firearm is carried lowered and inactive.
art_direction.scene: He pauses at the end of an immense sandstone colonnade, looking across a sunlit desert city while the scarf trails behind his shoulder. Keep one hand open and the lowered equipment clear of the legs. A low oblique viewpoint emphasizes upright composure; hard gold light and cool blue crayon shadows carve the figure against simple receding arches.
art_direction.palette: sand gold, ivory scarf, turquoise, indigo shadow
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
